# NeighborhoodScout

> > NeighborhoodScout provides comprehensive neighborhood analytics, crime risk assessments, school ratings, and real estate investment data for US and Canadian locations.

Developed by Location, Inc., NeighborhoodScout offers data-driven insights using FBI crime statistics, Census Bureau demographics, and Department of Education school performance data. The platform features SecurityGauge for address-level crime risk assessment and Scout Vision for real estate appreciation forecasting.

## Key Topics

- SecurityGauge crime risk assessment
- School ratings and public education rankings
- Real estate investment analysis
- Scout Vision appreciation forecasting
- FBI crime statistics
- Neighborhood demographics
- Safest cities rankings
- City and metro area comparisons
- Site selection analytics
- Census Bureau data
- Public safety metrics
- Home buyer research tools
- Address-level risk analytics
- NAEP education data

## Core Products and Services

- [SecurityGauge - NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/securitygauge): Crime risk assessment product for US/Canada addresses with API integration
- [Real Estate Data Products for Home Buyers and Sellers - NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/home-buyers-sellers): Comprehensive neighborhood reports for home buyers with schools and demographics
- [What are SecurityGauge Reports - NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/what-are-securitygauge-reports): Guide explaining SecurityGauge crime risk assessment reports for US/Canada

## Data Methodology and Sources

- [SecurityGauge Methodology - NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/securitygauge-methodology): Methodology for SecurityGauge address-level crime risk analytics using FBI data
- [Public School Rankings - Education Ratings for Every School & District – NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/about-the-data/school-ratings): School ratings methodology using NAEP data for district comparisons
- [Demographics Data, Trends and Forecasts - NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/about-the-data/demographics): Demographics methodology using Census data for neighborhood analytics

## Real Estate Investment Insights

- [All Investments Blogs | NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/blog/real-estate/investments): Real estate investment blog covering appreciation rates and Scout Vision
- [Best Towns to Buy a Second Home | NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/media/second-home): Coastal and mountain second home investment opportunities guide
- [Top Choices for Retiring Locally | NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/media/top-retire): Best retirement neighborhoods in America's top 10 metro areas analysis

## Safety and City Rankings

- [NeighborhoodScout's Safest Cities in America – 2022 - NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/blog/top100safest-2022): 2022 safest cities rankings led by Franklin, MA and Rexburg, ID
- [NeighborhoodScout's Safest Cities in America – 2021 - NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/blog/top100safest-2021): 2021 safest cities rankings featuring Rexburg, New Milford, and more
- [Top 100 Safest cities to live in the U.S. in 2019 | NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/blog/top100safest-2019): 2019 rankings of America's 100 safest cities by crime rates

## Family and School Resources

- [The Best neighborhoods for Families with Children to Buy a Home | NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/blog/family-friendly): Family-friendly neighborhoods guide combining schools, safety, and prices
- [Affordable Neighborhoods with the Best Schools in the U.S. | NeighborhoodScout](https://www.neighborhoodscout.com/blog/best-schools-affordable-neighborhoods): Top school districts by housing value in 20 largest US metro areas
